posts.author: PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body:
So I noticed that attack animations are really hard to find as far as free resources go. Why is that? Are they harder to make?
Does anybody know some good sources with lots of attack animations?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: I've noticed this myself. You might have to look at resources for platformers because they're more action heavy, but their character animations are only for sideways directions. It's probably because they're a lot of work to animate for 3+ directions and multiple frames.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Can you clarify what you're asking for?
Attack animation has a specific meaning in RPG Maker MV, the animation you select on a weapon to show when you attack with it.
I've seen these a number of places - artists' threads in the forum, some of the Animations Select packs.
But Aqua's reply is assuming you actually mean a graphic of the actor swinging their weapon on the map (which I would call a motion, to match the battler terminology, but that's not actually defined anywhere since it's not a part of the default engine).
